overview: You started the clean sheet with the workmen in the wood, and with the weaver correcting them. The verse was not on the leaf yet. The older pile stayed face down.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the page, read it back, and left the blank.

important_dates.meaning: Started the sheet with the workmen in the wood

summary: Wrote the page from the workmen through to the queen
